card.name: Mechanical parts moving or mounted
card.fires_on: Verbs and nouns describing how a mechanical part is held, mounted or moves, in descriptions of machines, vehicles and devices. It fires right after the part, as in 'needle moved' or 'steering axis'.

modes.label: Verbs of holding or fitting
modes.description: A verb saying how a part is kept in place, such as maintains, mounted, sits or hang.
modes.example: A yielding ring, as of metal, which surrounds a piston and<< maintains>> a tight fit, as inside a cylinder

modes.label: Verbs of part movement
modes.description: A verb saying a part moves, after a mechanical part used as the subject.
modes.example: Make sure the plunger<< moves>> smoothly before injecting the solution.

modes.description: The word axis or steering in vehicle geometry.
modes.example: the point where the steering<< axis>> hits the ground.
